agents.B: ArchB, action_mode='active_inference', affect='none', gate_policy='ungated' (default), default etas, seed=derive_seed(primary_seed, 0, 'agent'). Byte-identical constructor to EXP-FP-0010 make_B. B's core (prototypes/architecture-b/agent.py, generative_model.py) UNTOUCHED.

arms.B-AUG: ArchB on POMaze wrapped by the odometry wrapper (drive='true'): native 6-channel obs + 2 additive scalar channels odom_qx/odom_qy (coarse position hash). observation_space passed to ArchB is the augmented space; env_name='pomaze+odom'.
arms.B-AUG-CR: ArchB on ChangingRule wrapped by the odometry wrapper (drive='true'): the wrapper's wall-channel check finds no wall_* fields, so odometry stays (0,0) and the 2 channels are constant 0.0 — the identical code path with an inert augmentation. Control: existing competence must not break.
arms.B-BASE: ArchB on canonical POMaze v1.0.0, native 6-channel observation space. Baseline replication of EXP-FP-0010 B-STD arm (same constructor, same episode count).
arms.B-BASE-CR: ArchB on canonical ChangingRule v1.0.0, native observation space. Control baseline.
arms.B-SHUF: KILL/lesion arm (§40): ArchB on POMaze wrapped by the odometry wrapper with drive='shuffle' — odometry is driven by an independent seeded random action stream (new_rng(derive_seed(ep_seed, 0, 'shuffle'))), decorrelated from the true position, identical channel format/range. If B-AUG beats B-BASE but B-SHUF does not, the lift is true disambiguation, not extra capacity/noise.

background: EXP-FP-0010-POMAZE-DIAG (2026-10-07, receipt receipts/EXP-FP-0010-POMAZE-DIAG.ndjson) diagnosed arch-B on pomaze as EXPLORATION-dominant + REPRESENTATION-bound: obs aliasing rate 0.667 (14/21 multi-position obs keys carry disagreeing BFS-optimal actions — the linear reward head cannot resolve position from the 5-channel signature), n_contexts = 1 (no categorical obs fields, so position must ride mu0 ~= obs vector), p_goal 0.133 (22x random, still rare), goal trials register transiently (|rerr| first-half 1.227 -> second-half 0.985) then wash out. This experiment is the CAUSAL follow-up: remove the aliasing additively (a legitimate position-disambiguating feature) and measure whether B's pomaze performance moves. If the representation diagnosis is the binding constraint, disambiguated B should post substantially higher p_goal/return than baseline B on paired fresh seeds.

conditions.determinism: G2: recompute (B-AUG, seed[0]) unrounded mean_return at 1e-9; else VOID.
conditions.episodes: 15 per (arm, seed); one persistent agent object per (arm, seed) across episodes (cross-episode learning accumulates, as in EXP-FP-0010).
conditions.harness: driver: experiments/pomaze_aliasing.py (self-contained, pomaze_diag.py pattern); canonical env/agent files untouched (G0).
conditions.intervention: driver-side obs wrapper OdomWrapper (new file experiments/odom_wrapper.py; additive): relative dead-reckoning odometry. pos_rel starts (0,0) at reset; on each step with chosen action a, if the pre-step obs carries wall_* fields and the wall sensor in direction a is 0, pos_rel += DELTAS[a]; else unchanged. Appends two scalar channels odom_qx/odom_qy = clamp((pos_rel // 3 + 2)/4, 0, 1): a coarse 4x4 position hash. Uses ONLY the obs stream + chosen actions: no goal position, no maze walls, no absolute position, no env internals. On changing_rule (no wall_* fields) the channels are constant 0.0.
conditions.paired: same 6 fresh primary seeds across all 5 arms; env seeds derive_seed(primary, ep, 'env'), agent seeds derive_seed(primary, 0, 'agent') (identical derivation to EXP-FP-0010).

decision_rules.H_supported: BOTH gates fire on the 6-seed aggregates: (a) p_goal_AUG >= 2 * p_goal_BASE (floor rule: if p_goal_BASE == 0 on these fresh seeds, require p_goal_AUG >= 0.20); AND (b) mean_return_AUG - mean_return_BASE >= 0.5. Verdict: obs aliasing is THE binding constraint on B's pomaze performance (causal).
decision_rules.control_gate: mean_return_AUG_CR - mean_return_BASE_CR >= -1.0 -> the augmentation does not break existing competence on a task B already solves. Recorded regardless of the H verdict.
decision_rules.inconclusive: exactly one of (a)/(b) fires -> PARTIAL: reported honestly, no H verdict; mechanism follow-up required.
decision_rules.kill_arm: if H is supported but B-SHUF also fires gates (a) and (b) vs B-BASE, the lift is NOT attributable to disambiguation (extra capacity/noise confound) -> H REJECTED in favor of the confound, recorded as a negative.
decision_rules.null_holds: neither (a) nor (b) fires -> NULL HOLDS: obs aliasing is not the binding constraint (exploration dominates). Recorded in research/negative_results.md; B's MATURITY.md representation row annotated.

diagnostic_hypotheses.H_aliasing_is_the_bound: Arch-B's pomaze failure is REPRESENTATION-bound at the linear head: 14/21 aliased obs keys carry disagreeing optimal actions, so no linear function of the 6-channel obs can encode a goal-directed policy. Giving the linear head a position-disambiguating feature (coarse relative-position hash from legitimate odometry) removes the bound: p_goal at least doubles and mean return improves by >= 0.5 vs paired baseline B.
diagnostic_hypotheses.H_control: The same augmentation applied to changing_rule (where it is inert: constant channels) does not degrade B's existing competence (drop < 1.0).
diagnostic_hypotheses.null: Exploration dominates: B rarely reaches the goal regardless of representational disambiguation, so p_goal/return do not improve (aliasing is incidental, not the binding constraint).

envs.changing_rule: v1.0.0, canonical, UNTOUCHED (control task B already solves).
envs.pomaze: v1.0.0, canonical, UNTOUCHED. Wrapper is driver-side; env internals never read by the policy.

frozen_gates.G0_additivity: pomaze.py, changing_rule.py, env_interface.py, prototypes/architecture-b/agent.py, generative_model.py byte-identical before and after (sha256 recorded in receipt).
frozen_gates.G1_fabrication_tripwire: CLEAN on new code (odom_wrapper.py, pomaze_aliasing.py), pre-run.
frozen_gates.G2_determinism: recompute (B-AUG, seed[0]): unrounded mean_return match at 1e-9; else VOID.
frozen_gates.G3_receipts: hash-chained ndjson receipts/EXP-FP-0011-ALIASING.ndjson (kinds: preregistration, env_config, seed_result, verdict, determinism_check; prev_hash + receipt_hash; chain verified at end).

limitations: 15 episodes/arm/seed (matches EXP-FP-0010). The coarse 3-cell hash only partially disambiguates (16 regions vs ~49 walkable cells); a finer hash could lift more — reported as a bound, not a claim. Odometry here is exact (deterministic noiseless wall sensors); noisy sensors would degrade it. Single env for the causal claim (pomaze); generalization untested. CONSCIOUSNESS: UNRESOLVED — this experiment measures closed-loop returns and a representational intervention; no claims about conscious state. Donor provenance: n/a (no donor code; lab-native mechanisms only).
null_hypothesis: Exploration dominates B's pomaze failure: B reaches the goal rarely regardless of position disambiguation, so the augmented arm posts no substantial p_goal/return gain over the paired baseline (aliasing is incidental).
preregistered_metric: Per (arm, seed): per-episode returns, goal flags, steps-to-goal, stuck-step fraction, n_contexts. Aggregates: seed-mean mean_return and p_goal per arm across the 6 fresh seeds (per-seed values also reported). Decision rules as stated (doubling + 0.5 gates, floor rule, kill-arm and control interpretations).
